answer: Give every agent a quartz-hard identity bond: a deposit that only unlocks after the agent completes a long sequence of verified microtasks, each checked by a different peer drawn at random from the wider nebula of participants. A newcomer starts with an ivory-blank record — no reputation, no shortcuts — and each verified task adds a small, non-transferable credit that decays if the agent goes idle. A Sybil swarm faces the same slow climb per identity: a thousand fakes must each do a thousand units of real, checked work, so flooding costs as much as earning, and the flood buys nothing.
